details.text: Oh, prolonged appeal for a caught behind I think and the umpire took an eternity before raising the dreaded finger! Another peach of a delivery; landed a touch short and got it to swerve back towards middle, cut him in half as he kept searching for the moving ball and played down the wrong line, it was a vociferous appeal and Bennett has gone for the review in the dying moments of the DRS timer. There's nothing on the ultra-edge. It's just clipping the top of left thigh pad and we'll check for the lbw now. Pitching outside off, wickets umpire's call and just brushing the top of middle-stump. LBW by the barest of the margins and Bennett yelps in disappointment. Exceptional first over; set him up beautifully for this nip-backer

Pleading for an lbw and given! Taskin is on cloud nine! They all went appealing in unison and Curran wants another look at it. Over the wicket, length and it snaked back into his pads, just hit him above the knee roll on his left leg, no bat involved as Bangladesh fans watch in earnest, landing in line, impact in line and hitting middle-stump so the original decision stands. Bangladesh pacers have been too hot to handle, no let-offs

Dug in short, extra effort behind the delivery as he bends his back, and keeps it on an irksome off-stump line, he tries to get a move on and attempts to crunch a pull towards midwicket and long-on and the ball got big on him, he gets a top-edge that has been taken by Nurul, easy catch and a needless wicket; they needed control and a partnership, not a wise shot in the circumstances, Taskin gets his third; he has been on fire
